description: Major Power Outage Risks in the U.S. (2000-2016) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset includes the major outages witnessed by different states in the continental U.S. Besides major outages, this data contains information on geographical location of the outages, regional climatic information, land-use characteristics, electricity consumption patterns and economic characteristics of the states affected by the outages. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are outage data, electricity outages, electric power failures. The portal shows 2024-06-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
